items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Delta. Nearest rapid-transit station: Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), reached by TransLink Route 601 from Ladner Exchange.
Nearest bus exchange: Ladner Exchange, served by Routes 601, 616, 617 and 618.

Route 601 Bridgeport Station/South Delta (TransLink): from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Rd, Hwy 17A and Hwy 99 to Bridgeport Station.

items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Port Guichon name.
Walks dropped over the 1.5 km cap: Ladner Leisure Centre (3.64 km) and Ladner Pioneer Library (1.76 km).

faq.q: Which elementary school is in Port Guichon?
faq.a: Port Guichon Elementary (K–7), at 4381 46a St, Delta, on the BC Ministry of Education's SD37 school list. Whether a specific Port Guichon address is in its catchment must be checked in the SD37 locator — catchments are address-based.

faq.q: Can a Port Guichon lot add a suite or coach house?
faq.a: Delta's SSMUH zoning updates allow up to four units on all single-detached and duplex lots, and the City supports accessory dwelling units such as coach houses, garden suites and secondary suites; the live feed already shows coach-house half duplexes on Savoy Street. What applies to a specific lot is a City parcel check.

faq.q: How do Port Guichon residents reach the Canada Line?
faq.a: By TransLink route 601, which runs from South Delta via South Delta Exchange and Ladner Exchange to Bridgeport Station, via Highway 17, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.

faq.q: What plan governs development in Port Guichon?
faq.a: The Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan; its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5) carries the land-use designations, and there is no separate Ladner area-plan schedule in it.
